title: Rappler Recap: ASEAN talks trade and beyond with China, Australia, South Korea, UN
summary: Here’s a rundown of the developments on the second day of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits

blocks.text: Here’s a rundown of the developments on the second day of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits

MANILA, Philippines – On the second day of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, leaders from around the region and beyond meet to discuss common issues such as trade and climate change, as well as more contentious ones, including navigation in the South China Sea.
Rappler’s Lance Spencer Yu walks you through the events and developments on Monday, November 16. – Rappler.com
